name: Omaremote
author: Mathew
description: View and control the other computers on your tailnet from the Omarchy bar: pick a machine and its desktop opens fullscreen at your screen's resolution

barWidget.description: Lists your online tailnet machines. Click one to view and control its desktop.

schema.label: Mirror the real monitor
schema.description: Show the remote's own monitor in a window, instead of a fullscreen virtual screen sized to yours

schema.label: H.264
schema.description: Hardware video encoding: smoother on slow links and for video, slightly washed-out colors
